paragraphs: Nextdoor is the essential neighborhood network connecting over 105 million Verified Neighbors1 to the people, places, and information that matter most in their local communities. Operating in over 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries, Nextdoor fosters trusted, real-world utility through locally relevant content and services, including news, real-time safety alerts, neighbor recommendations, for sale and free listings, and events. This focus on practical local value drives genuine, high-intent local engagement and supports a diverse ecosystem of neighbors and partners seeking to connect with neighbors.

Our platform is powered by unique geospatial technology and a proprietary advertising system that enables businesses of all sizes to reach highly engaged audiences with a local focus. Through these capabilities, Nextdoor helps strengthen local communities while providing partners — including small businesses, national brands, publishers, and civic and government agencies — with effective tools to communicate and engage locally at scale.
As of December 31, 2025, Nextdoor had 21.0 million Platform Weekly Active Users ("Platform WAU") and reached 1 in 3 households in the United States.

In 2025, we launched the new Nextdoor initiative, the first phase of a multi‑phase product transformation designed to create more engaging experiences for neighbors and partners and deliver enhanced value for advertisers. This evolution expands the platform beyond primarily neighbor-generated content to a dynamic feed enriched with timely, locally relevant information — including news and alerts — with artificial intelligence ("AI") and machine learning ("ML") used to help surface and personalize content for neighbors.

Nextdoor is built on the unique combination of neighbor identity, trust and proximity. Our platform is powered by our core constituencies: neighbors, businesses, and public agencies seeking to build stronger, more connected communities. Neighbors use Nextdoor to connect with their neighbors, follow local news, participate in conversations, discover and support local businesses, and exchange goods and services. Businesses use our platform to reach high-intent audiences through free Business Pages and targeted advertising, while public agencies — including fire departments, law enforcement, and municipal offices — share real-time updates, critical alerts, and community information.

This ecosystem is further enhanced by more than 4,000 local news publishers whose content accounted, as of December 31, 2025, for approximately 7% of total feed volume, as well as alert partners such as Waze, Weather.com, and the U.S. Geological Survey. These partnerships deliver real-time traffic, weather, and safety notifications, increasing the relevance and utility of our platform.

The user experience anchors on the Feed, a dynamic, personalized stream of neighbor posts, discussions, news, alerts, and community updates tailored by location. Our Search functionality connects neighbors to local businesses and resources, enabling discovery and recommendations that help drive visibility and loyalty for local businesses. Additionally, For Sale & Free facilitates a local marketplace where neighbors can buy, sell, or donate items within their communities.

Our platform is built on a rich local data set that includes event details, recommendations, and insights into neighbor and neighborhood interests and behaviors. This proprietary data powers our unique local knowledge and neighbor graph, enabling more relevant content experiences for neighbors and more effective advertising solutions for businesses.

Through ongoing enhancements in AI and ML capabilities, we continue to improve content personalization, notification relevance, and ad performance. By seamlessly connecting neighbors, businesses, and public agencies, we continue to evolve Nextdoor into the most useful, real-time resource for neighborhoods—with a clear ambition: if it's happening in your neighborhood, it's on Nextdoor.
1 Verified Neighbors are individuals who have joined Nextdoor and completed the verification process for their account.

Nextdoor offers a comprehensive suite of advertising solutions designed to deliver measurable results for businesses of all sizes. Our Nextdoor Ads Platform is built on a proprietary ad stack that includes the Nextdoor Ads Manager interface, our native ad server, and measurement and API tools. Together, these capabilities help businesses to connect with high-intent local audiences, build brand awareness, and drive customer engagement where decisions are made: in the neighborhood. To help businesses achieve these goals, we provide a range of key features and benefits:

•Hyperlocal Targeting: Powered by our first-party data from over 105 million Verified Neighbors, Nextdoor's unique neighborhood-level targeting capabilities helps advertisers reach validated audiences based on neighborhood, interests, and real-world behavior. This is designed to help campaigns reach the most relevant neighborhoods to enhance impact.

•Diverse Ad Formats: We offer a variety of engaging ad formats, including sponsored posts, lead generation forms, native display ads, and video ads to cater to different marketing objectives and creative strategies. In 2025, we expanded our creative capabilities with AI-powered tools that help advertisers generate locally relevant copy and imagery at scale.

•Ad Auction and Delivery: Our ad auction system prioritizes ad relevance, quality, and user experience. Our algorithms analyze user interests, demographics, and historical behavior to optimize performance for advertisers while maintaining feed quality for neighbors.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
Adverse global economic and financial conditions could harm our business and financial condition.

We currently generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. If advertisers reduce or eliminate their spending with us, our business, operating results, and financial condition would be adversely impacted.

Our ability to attract and retain advertisers depends on our ability to collect and use data and develop products to enable us to effectively deliver and accurately measure advertisements on the Nextdoor platform.

If we fail to add new neighbors or retain current neighbors, or if current neighbors engage less with the Nextdoor platform, our business, operating results, and financial condition would be adversely impacted.
Our business is highly competitive. Competition presents an ongoing threat to the success of our business.
If we fail to scale our business effectively, our business, operating results, and financial condition would be adversely affected.
We may not be successful in our AI initiatives, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results.

If our efforts to build strong brand identity and reputation are not successful, we may not be able to attract or retain neighbors, and our business, operating results, and financial condition will be adversely affected.
Unfavorable media coverage negatively affects our business from time to time.
Our product and investment decisions may conflict with the short-term financial results and may not produce the long-term benefits that we expect.
If we need additional capital in the future, it may not be available on favorable terms, if at all.
We may make acquisitions, which could harm our financial condition or operating results and may adversely affect the price of our Class A common stock.
paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves risks. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report, including the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before deciding whether to purchase shares of our Class A common stock. You should also carefully consider the following risk factors in addition to the other information included in this Annual Report, including matters addressed in the above section entitled "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements." Our business, operating results, financial condition, and prospects could also be harmed by risks and uncertainties that are not presently known to us or that we currently believe are not material. If any of these risks actually occur, our business, operating results, financial condition, and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. Unless otherwise indicated, references in these risk factors to our business being harmed will include harm to our business, reputation, brand, financial condition, operating results, and prospects. In such event, the market price of our securities could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment.

We have a limited operating history at the current scale of our business and are still scaling up our monetization efforts, which makes it difficult to evaluate our current business and future prospects, and there is no assurance we will be able to scale our business for future growth.

We commenced operating the Nextdoor platform in 2011 and began supporting the platform with advertising in 2016. In 2025, we launched our new Nextdoor initiative, the first phase of a multi‑phase product transformation with the goal of making our platform more robust and engaging for users, as well as more compelling for advertisers. This initiative remains ongoing as we continue to implement additional features and enhancements. These changes may not be favorably received by users or advertisers, may not result in increased engagement or monetization, and may disrupt established usage patterns or alienate existing users. Our limited operating history at the current scale of our business may make it difficult to evaluate our current business and future prospects. We have encountered, and will continue to encounter, risks and difficulties frequently experienced by growing companies in rapidly evolving industries, including challenges in accurate financial planning and forecasting, increasing competition and expenses as we effectively scale our business, and our ability to achieve market acceptance of our platform and attract, engage and retain users, who we call "neighbors" (which includes individuals) and organizations (which includes businesses and public agencies, including paying customers such as advertisers). You should consider our business and prospects in light of the risks and difficulties that we may encounter as a business with a limited operating history. We cannot ensure that we will be successful in addressing these and other challenges we may face in the future, and our business, operating results, and financial condition may be adversely affected if we do not manage these risks successfully. We may not be able to sustain or increase our current rate of growth, which is a risk characteristic often shared by companies with limited operating histories participating in rapidly evolving industries.

Additionally, we are still in the early stages of monetizing our platform. Our growth strategy depends on, among other things, increasing neighbors on the network, increasing engagement, developing new and improving existing products for neighbors and organizations, attracting more advertisers (including expanding our sales efforts to reach advertisers in additional international markets), scaling our business with existing advertisers, and delivering targeted advertisements based on neighbors' personal taste and interests. Given the current macroeconomic environment, it may be more difficult for us to capitalize on our growth strategies. There can be no assurance that we will successfully increase monetization on our platform or that we will sustain or increase the current growth rate of our revenue.

Adverse global economic and financial events and the effects thereof, such as health epidemics or pandemics, geopolitical conflicts, inflation, changing interest rates, potential recessions, the implementation of tariffs by the United States, China, or other governments, fluctuations in foreign exchange rates, actual or perceived instability in the global banking system, supply chain issues and inventory and labor shortages, have caused, and could in the future cause, disruptions and volatility in global financial markets. These conditions have in the past and may in the future translate to cost increases to us and advertisers and lead to decreased spending by our advertisers. U.S. trade policies, including tariffs on imported goods, may adversely affect economic conditions and consumer spending patterns. Current and potential U.S. tariffs, and any new or additional retaliatory tariffs that may be imposed by other countries in response to such U.S. tariffs, may adversely affect spending by advertisers and, consequently, our operating results. Trade policy uncertainty and tariff implementations may continue to contribute to market volatility and economic uncertainty. We are closely monitoring this evolving situation and there can be no assurance that we will be able to mitigate the impacts of any trade measures on our business, which could adversely impact our business, operating results, financial condition, and our stock price. In addition, since the majority of our revenue is derived from advertisers within the United States, economic conditions in the United States have a
greater impact on us. We may not perform well in adverse macroeconomic conditions, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition and operating results.

Discussions regarding our financial condition and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023 are located in Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on February 27, 2025.

Nextdoor is the essential neighborhood network connecting over 105 million Verified Neighbors to the people, places, and information that matter most in their local communities. Operating in over 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries, Nextdoor fosters trusted, real-world utility through locally relevant content and services, including news, real-time safety alerts, neighbor recommendations, for sale and free listings, and events. This focus on practical local value drives genuine, high-intent local engagement and supports a diverse ecosystem of neighbors and partners seeking to connect with neighbors.
Key business metrics for the three months ended December 31, 2025 are as follows:
•Platform weekly active users ("Platform WAU") was 21.0 million, a decrease of 5% compared to the three months ended December 31, 2024.
•Average revenue per platform weekly active user ("Platform ARPU") was $3.31, an increase of 13% compared to the three months ended December 31, 2024.

paragraphs: Nextdoor 是連接超過 105 百萬已驗證鄰居至其當地社區中重要人物、場所和資訊的必要社區網路。在 11 個國家的超過 350,000 個社區運作，Nextdoor 透過當地相關的內容與服務，包括新聞、即時安全警報、鄰居推薦、買賣與免費刊登以及活動，促進值得信賴的現實世界實用性。這種對實用當地價值的關注，驅動真實且高意圖的當地參與，並支持多元的鄰居與夥伴生態系統，以連結鄰居。
我們的平台由獨特的地理空間科技與專有廣告系統所驅動，使各規模企業都能以當地為焦點，觸及高度參與的受眾。透過這些能力，Nextdoor 幫助強化當地社區，同時為夥伴 — 包括小型企業、全國品牌、出版商以及公民與政府機構 — 提供有效的工具，以規模化的方式進行本地溝通與參與。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Nextdoor 有 21.0 百萬平台每週活躍用戶（"Platform WAU"），並觸及美國 1 在 3 的家庭。
在 2025 年，我們啟動了新的 Nextdoor 計畫，這是多階段產品轉型的第一階段，旨在為鄰居與夥伴創造更吸引人的體驗，並為廣告主提供增強的價值。這項演進將平台拓展至不僅僅是鄰居產生的內容，而是一個動態的資訊流，包含即時、當地相關的資訊 — 包括新聞與警報 — 並透過人工智慧（"AI"）與機器學習（"ML"）協助表面與個人化內容給鄰居。

Nextdoor 建立在鄰居身分、信任與距離的獨特組合之上。我們的平台由我們的核心 constituency：鄰居、企業與公共機構所驅動，這些機構致力於建立更強、更連結的社區。鄰居使用 Nextdoor 來與鄰居連結、追蹤本地新聞、參與對話、發現並支持本地企業，以及交換商品與服務。企業使用我們的平台透過免費企業頁面與目標廣告來觸及高意圖的受眾，而公共機構 — 包括消防部門、執法部門與市政府辦公室 — 則分享即時更新、關鍵警報與社區資訊。
這個生態系統進一步由超過 4,000 家本地新聞出版商增強，這些出版商的內容，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，約佔總資訊流體積的 7%。此外，還包括如 Waze、Weather.com 與美國地質調查局等警報夥伴。這些合作夥伴提供即時的交通、天氣與安全通知，提高我們平台的相關性與實用性。
用戶體驗以 Feed 為核心，這是一個動態、個人化的資訊流，包含鄰居的發文、討論、新聞、警報與社區更新，並根據地點進行調整。我們的搜尋功能讓鄰居與本地企業與資源連結，促進發現與推薦，協助提升本地企業的可見度與忠誠度。此外，買賣與免費功能促成了一個本地市場，讓鄰居可以在社區內買賣或捐贈物品。
我們的平台建立在豐富的本地數據集之上，包括活動細節、推薦與對鄰居與社區興趣與行為的洞察。這項專有數據驅動我們獨特的本地知識與鄰居圖譜，使鄰居能獲得更相關的內容體驗，並為企業提供更有效的廣告解決方案。
透過持續提升人工智能與機器學習能力，我們持續改善內容個人化、通知相關性與廣告表現。透過順暢連結鄰居、企業與公家機關，我們持續將 Nextdoor 發展為 neighbourhood 最實用、即時的資源－我們明確的願景為：如果 neighbourhood 有發生什麼事，就一定能在 Nextdoor 上找到。
1 已驗證的鄰居是指已加入 Nextdoor 並完成帳號驗證程序的個人。

Nextdoor 提供一套完整的廣告解決方案，旨在為各規模的企業帶來可衡量的成果。我們的 Nextdoor 廣告平台建於專屬的廣告堆疊上，包含 Nextdoor 廣告管理介面、我們的原生廣告伺服器，以及測量與 API 工具。這些能力協助企業與高意圖的本地化受眾連結、建立品牌認知度，並在 neighbourhood 中推動消費者參與，因為決策就在 neighbourhood 進行。為協助企業達成這些目標，我們提供一系列關鍵功能與好處：
•Hyperlocal Targeting: 由我們來自超過 105 百萬已驗證鄰居的第一手資料驅動，Nextdoor 獨有的社區層級定位能力，協助廣告主根據社區、興趣及現實行為，觸及已驗證的受眾。此功能旨在幫助廣告活動觸及最相關的社區，以增強影響力。
• 多樣廣告格式：我們提供多種吸引人的廣告格式，包括 sponsored posts、lead generation forms、原生展示廣告與 video ads，以符合不同的行銷目標與創意策略。2025 年，我們透過 AI 系統工具擴展了創意能力，協助廣告主大量生成符合本地化需求的文案與影像。
• 廣告競標與投放：我們的廣告競標系統優先考量廣告相關性、品質與用戶體驗。我們的演算法分析用戶興趣、人口統計與歷史行為，以優化廣告主的表現，同時維護 neighbourhood 的內容品質。

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析提供資訊，本公司管理階層認為此資訊與評估及瞭解本公司合併營運成果與財務狀況有關。討論應與本公司合併財務報表及相關附註一同閱讀，這些財務報表及附註載於本年度報告之其他部分。此討論可能包含基於目前預期的展望性陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。本公司實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述中預期的結果有重大差異，原因可能包括於「特別提醒展望性陳述」及「風險因素」或本年度報告其他部分所列舉的因素。
有關本公司2025年12月31日財務狀況與營運成果與2024年12月31日財務狀況與營運成果之比較討論，請參見下文。有關本公司2024年12月31日財務狀況與營運成果與2023年12月31日財務狀況與營運成果之比較討論，請參見本年度報告Form 10-K之Part II, Item 7, "管理階層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析"，該部分於2025年2月27日提交至SEC。
Nextdoor為一個重要的社區網路，連結超過105百萬經驗證的鄰居，與他們當地社區中最重要的人民、地點與資訊。經營於11個國家超過350,000個社區，Nextdoor透過與當地相關的內容與服務，促進值得信賴、真實世界的實用性，包括新聞、即時安全警報、鄰居推薦、買賣與免費刊登資訊，以及活動。此對實用當地價值的專注，驅動真實、高意圖的當地參與，並支持多元的鄰居與夥伴生態系統，以與鄰居建立連結。
2025年12月31日財務資料之關鍵業務指標如下：
•平台每週活躍用戶數（"Platform WAU"）為21.0百萬，與2024年12月31日財務資料之三月比較減少5%。
•平台每週活躍用戶平均收入（"Platform ARPU"）為3.31美元，與2024年12月31日財務資料之三月比較增加13%。
2025年12月31日財務資料如下：
•營業收入為257.6百萬美元，與2024年比較增加4%。
•總成本及費用為 329.6 百萬美元，較 2024 年減少 11%。
•淨虧損減少 45% 至 2025 年的 54.2 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 98.1 百萬美元。
•調整後的 EBITDA 在 2025 年為正 0.6 百萬美元，較 2024 年的虧損 18.2 百萬美元。
•現金、現金等價物及市場可交易證券為 404.8 百萬美元。
請參閱下方的 "Non-GAAP 財務指標" 以取得更多資訊，並瞭解淨虧損（最接近的財務指標，依美國通用會計準則（"GAAP"）計算及呈現）與調整後 EBITDA 之間的換算關係。
2025 年 8 月，我們宣佈了一項成本削減計畫，旨在使業務規模與業務優先順序相符，並調整人力及其他費用。該成本削減計畫在 2025 年第三季末已基本執行完畢。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關之風險
不利之全球經濟與財務環境可能損害我們之業務與財務狀況。
目前我們 substantially all 之營業收入來自廣告。若廣告客戶減少或終止對我們之支出，將不利於我們之業務、營運結果與財務狀況。
我們吸引並留住廣告客戶之能力，取決於我們蒐集與使用資料，以及開發產品以有效於 Nextdoor 平台投放與準確衡量廣告之能力。
若我們未能增加新住民或留住現有住民，或現有住民於 Nextdoor 平台參與度降低，將不利於我們之業務、營運結果與財務狀況。
我們之業務競爭激烈。競爭對我們業務之成功構成持續威脅。

paragraphs: 投資本公司 A 級普通股涉及風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度財務報告中所有其他資訊，包括「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」一節，以及我們的合併財務報表與相關附註，以決定是否購買本公司 A 級普通股。您也應仔細考慮下列風險因素，並配合本年度財務報告中其他資訊，包括上述「特別說明前瞻性陳述」一節。本公司營運、營運成果、財務狀況與前景可能因目前未知或本公司認為不具重大影響之風險與不確定性而受損。若任何上述風險實際發生，本公司營運、營運成果、財務狀況與前景可能受到重大且不利的影響。除非另有說明，本風險因素中提及本公司營運受損，將包括對本公司營運、聲譽、品牌、財務狀況、營運成果與前景之損害。在此情況下，本公司證券之市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
本公司目前營運規模之營運歷史有限，且仍在擴大 monetization 努力，這使評估本公司目前營運與未來前景變得困難，且無法保證本公司能成功擴大營運以實現未來成長。

我們於 2011 年開始運作 Nextdoor 平台，並於 2016 年開始透過廣告支援該平台。2025 年，我們啟動了我們的新 Nextdoor 計畫，這是多階段產品轉型的第一階段，目標為使平台對用戶更具吸引力與互動性，同時對廣告商更具吸引力。此計畫目前仍在進行中，我們持續實施更多功能與改進。這些變更可能不被用戶或廣告商所接受，可能不會導致用戶參與度或 monetization 增加，也可能幹擾既有的使用習慣或使現有用戶感到不滿。本公司目前營運規模之營運歷史有限，可能使評估本公司目前營運與未來前景變得困難。我們已遇到，並將持續遇到快速發展產業中成長公司常見的風險與困難，包括準確財務規劃與預測的挑戰、在有效擴大營運時面對的競爭與費用增加，以及本公司能否取得平台市場接受度，吸引、留住用戶（包括個人）與組織（包括企業與公家機關，包括廣告商等付款客戶）。您應考量本公司營運與前景，並視本公司營運歷史有限所可能遇到的風險與困難。我們無法保證能成功解決這些及其他未來可能遇到的挑戰，若無法成功管理這些風險，本公司營運、營運成果與財務狀況可能受到不利影響。我們可能無法維持或提高目前的成長速度，這是營運歷史有限且參與快速發展產業公司常見的風險特徵。

此外，我們仍處於將平台商業化的初期階段。我們的成長策略取決於諸多因素，包括增加網路上的鄰居人數、提高參與度、為鄰居與組織開發新產品及改善現有產品、吸引更多廣告客戶（包括擴大銷售努力以接觸更多國際市場的廣告客戶）、以現有廣告客戶擴大業務規模，以及根據鄰居的個人品味與興趣提供定向廣告。考慮到目前的總體經濟環境，我們可能更難以實現成長策略。無法保證我們能成功提高平台的商業化程度，或能維持或提高目前的營業收入成長率。

不利的全球經濟與金融事件及其影響，例如健康疫情或大流行、地緣政治衝突、通貨膨脹、利率變動、潛在經濟衰退、美國、中國或其他政府實施關稅、外匯匯率波動、全球銀行體系實際或被認為的不穩定、供應鏈問題及存貨與勞動力短缺，已導致並可能在未來導致全球金融市場的幹擾與波動。這些情況過去已導致我們與廣告客戶的成本增加，並可能在未來導致廣告客戶支出減少。美國貿易政策，包括對進口商品的關稅，可能不利於經濟狀況與消費者支出模式。目前與潛在的美國關稅，以及任何因應美國關稅而可能由其他國家實施的新或額外報復性關稅，可能不利於廣告客戶的支出，進而影響我們的營運結果。貿易政策的不確定性與關稅實施可能持續導致市場波動與經濟不確定性。我們密切關注此一持續演變的情況，無法保證我們能緩解任何貿易措施對我們業務的影響，這可能會對我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況與股票價格產生負面影響。此外，由於我們的收入絕大多數來自美國境內的廣告客戶，美國的經濟狀況對我們的影響較大。在不利的總體經濟條件下，我們的表現可能不佳，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運結果產生負面影響。
